notes: The document contradicts itself: one line item at $329.00, subtotal $329.00, tax $0.00, but TOTAL DUE $339.00. total_cents records the printed total ($339.00) as the extracted field, with the disagreement as the finding. Note that the price delta alone would not carry the case: $339.00 against PO-2202's $329.00 is $10.00, inside max(2%, $25) = $25.00 tolerance, and the amount is under the autonomy cap. The hold is on the internal inconsistency itself: subtotal plus tax must equal total, and when the payable amount is unknowable the run cannot auto-approve. exception_hold with a drafted request for a corrected invoice. The deterministic reference matcher (packages/pipeline/src/match.ts) compares only the total against the PO and does not cross-check subtotal plus tax, so the mock lane will not reproduce this hold; the case grades the model path.
